canonical_json.profile_scope: RFC 8785 canonical output over the constrained CABT safe-I-JSON profile; this is not a claim of unrestricted generic JCS input support
canonical_json.input: an exact in-memory JSON tree, or strict UTF-8 JSON bytes without a leading BOM, parsed with duplicate object keys rejected before materialization
canonical_json.utf8_bom: forbidden at the document boundary; a leading EF BB BF byte sequence is invalid_json in every executor
canonical_json.integer_nodes: Python int and GDScript int nodes are accepted only in the exact interoperable range -(2^53-1)..(2^53-1); bool never impersonates int
canonical_json.binary64_nodes: finite IEEE-754 binary64 values remain binary64 even when integer-valued; RFC 8785 samples such as 2^53 are valid float values, not integer nodes
canonical_json.decimal_json_numbers: strict JSON bytes parsing converts decimal or exponent number tokens to correctly rounded IEEE-754 binary64 before RFC 8785 serialization; integer lexical tokens remain integer nodes
canonical_json.invalid_unicode: reject lone surrogates and every Unicode noncharacter in object keys and string values, including U+FDD0..U+FDEF and each plane's U+FFFE/U+FFFF
canonical_json.missing_vs_null: missing is absent from an object; explicit null serializes as null

domain_separation.prefix_construction: ASCII PTCGDAP, one NUL byte, ASCII CABT_TREE_HASH_V1, one NUL byte, the ASCII domain name, then one NUL byte

raw_private.input_tree: RawCabtEnvelope.raw_payload exactly as received as a parsed JSON tree
raw_private.precondition: root object contains select, logs, current, and search_begin_input; search_begin_input is string or null
raw_private.visibility: Host-private; forbidden in public traces and policy input

token_free_callback.input_tree: a deep copy of the same RawCabtEnvelope.raw_payload used by raw_private
token_free_callback.transformation: replace only the root /search_begin_input value with the exact presence marker declared below; preserve every other key, value, JSON type, missing/null distinction, and array order
token_free_callback.visibility: Host binding identity; not policy input before firewall acceptance

public_observation.input_tree: the immutable allow-list PublicObservation tree emitted by the public firewall after firewall_status becomes accepted
public_observation.precondition: the firewall has constructed and accepted a separate public projection; the tree contains neither the search_begin_input key nor its presence marker
public_observation.relationship: this is not raw_payload and is not the token_free_callback tree; it is a separately supplied public projection
public_observation.transformation: none after the firewall projection is supplied
public_observation.unknown_field_rule: raw additive fields stay quarantined and absent unless a later reviewed public schema explicitly allow-lists them; every key actually present in the accepted projection is hashed

domain_separation.digest_input: prefix bytes followed immediately by RFC 8785 canonical JSON bytes

search_capability_normalization.source_values: a non-empty or empty JSON string means present; JSON null means absent; missing or any other type is a contract error

limits.node_counting: count the root and every array element or object value as JSON values; object keys are not separate nodes

public_firewall.accepted_input: the exact allow-list PublicObservation output tree described by domain_contracts.public_observation
public_firewall.rejected_behavior: no public hash, no policy call, audited later legal fallback contract

canonical_json_v1_subset.runtime_types: exact object/list/string/integer/boolean/null; no host subtypes or floats
canonical_json_v1_subset.invalid_unicode: reject lone surrogates and every Unicode noncharacter in object keys and string values

implementation.cross_runtime_status: shared_vectors_passed_offline; no live owner or public firewall claim
